limitations: Unweighted standard hypercube with coordinate star only; full host Parseval analysis only; not a minimum-dimension general Cayley embedding or solver-conditioning statement. Boundary Hilbert norms are unnormalized counting norms. The leaf-contrast asymptotic holds as dimension tends to infinity.
scientific_integrity: Closed-form spectrum proved by harmonic measure, permutation symmetry and a shifted-cube Walsh resolvent. Standalone direct grounded-Laplacian comparisons use exact rational arithmetic in dimensions 2 through 6; computations are supplemental to the all-dimensional proof.
title: A three-sector Walsh spectrum for harmonic star completion in a binary cube
